coordinator_decision.context: Close the no-run version-2 matched-density implementation preflight after independent theory, accounting, and red-team review.
rationale: Version 2 correctly repairs the primary density-frontier objective, distinguishes formal-multiset from ordered-tuple energy, names both retention denominators, and emits replayable local frontier states.
Independent review showed that the document verifier accepts empty or incomplete matrices and does not freeze the paired four-null gate.
Curve transcripts and hash-derived Mobius parameters are producer-controlled, schemas admit appended scalar material, and the present gap replay cannot independently prove an omitted branch absent.
Operation and byte receipts are internally additive but do not form a complete, order-independent accounting of working memory, serialization, verifier work, or cap-local cost.
The tested object depends on the lexicographically least degree-two representative compiler, so any eventual effect must be scoped to the combined predicate-and-compiler construction.
limitations: No version-2 curve-family row or canonical run was created.
The twelve passing tests are frozen-fixture and implementation controls, not family evidence.
A locally well-formed frontier list is not by itself a branch-completeness proof.
No relation generation, rank, target descent, preprocessing crossover, rho comparison, exponent, or ECDLP result is in scope.
next_actions: Freeze a version-3 representative compiler and exact paired-null gate, including median, tie, cap, duplicate, and unresolved-cell rules.
Close row and document schemas and independently derive curve draws, Mobius parameters, and factor-base provenance.
Reject incomplete matrices and every scalar, provenance, objective, operation, and empty-document mutation accepted by version 2.
Make row-shared and cap-local accounting order-independent, and label nested bytes, retained object size, wall time, and search counters without claiming an additive full-system cost.
Obtain fresh independent theory, accounting, and red-team GO before changing canonical maximum_runs above zero.
